labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Strict Mode now unmounts and remounts every component on first mount in development, which can break components not resilient to remounting with existing state.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Effects are now synchronously flushed for updates triggered in discrete input events, a timing behavior change that could affect code relying on previous effect timing.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Hydration mismatches in text content are now errors that cause client rendering up to the nearest Suspense boundary instead of warnings with patching, which can change app behavior for SSR users.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Suspense now discards incomplete trees and retries from scratch without firing effects, a behavior change that may affect components that suspend before fully mounting.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Layout effects are now cleaned up and re-created when Suspense re-suspends, a behavior change that can affect components relying on layout effects not re-running.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: React now requires Promise, Symbol, and Object.assign, so apps supporting older browsers like IE need polyfills.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The unstable scheduler/tracing API is removed, which could break users depending on it.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Components can now return undefined without throwing, a relaxation that doesn't break existing code and needs no action.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: act warnings are now opt-in, which changes test behavior and may require enabling the opt-in mechanism for unit tests to keep getting warnings.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: A warning about setState on unmounted components was removed, which requires no user action.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Console log suppression in Strict Mode double renders was removed, so users will now see duplicate logs, which is a visible behavior change that may affect log-based tooling or expectations.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Memory cleanup on unmount is improved internally and requires no user action.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: renderToString no longer errors when suspending and instead emits fallback HTML and retries on the client, a server rendering behavior change.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: renderToStaticMarkup no longer errors when suspending and instead emits fallback HTML, changing server output behavior.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Adds new useTransition and useDeferredValue APIs, a purely additive feature.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Adds the new useId hook, a purely additive feature.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Adds the new useSyncExternalStore hook, a purely additive feature.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Adds the startTransition API, a purely additive feature.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: Adds the useInsertionEffect hook, a purely additive feature.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Suspense now remounts layout effects when content reappears, a behavior change that may affect existing layout effect logic.
